# SCADA and IIoT software, _built in India_ for the world.

Connect the shop floor to the top floor with Vision C, Vision S and Vision Web. One suite for data logging, remote monitoring and regulated manufacturing — deployed in 1,000+ plants across twelve industries.

The layer between

## From a sensor on a machine to a decision on a phone.

Dicot makes the software layer between industrial equipment and the people who run it: collect data, keep it safe, show it clearly and raise the alarm when something drifts.

**800+** customers

**1,000+**deployments

**4,000+**device protocols

**50–100 ms**cloud update latency

The data path

## One path from PLC to PDF.

Each product does one job in the same chain. Start at the machine, add plant-wide visibility, then put the evidence in front of the person who needs it.

1.  01 / Collect
    
    ### Vision C
    
    Reads Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD and AIBUS from one machine or line. Up to 100 tags, logged locally.
    
2.  02 / Run the plant
    
    ### Vision S
    
    Enterprise SCADA for multi-line plants: 4,000+ protocols, OPC UA/DA and 21 CFR-ready audit trails.
    
3.  03 / Reach people
    
    ### Vision Web
    
    Hosted cloud SCADA with 50–100 ms updates and alarms by SMS, email, WhatsApp and Telegram.
    
4.  04 / Report
    
    ### VGraphic
    
    Turns Excel, CSV, SQL and DAT files into branded PDF tables and graphs, on desktop or phone.

How we work

## Industrial software without the industrial project.

Most SCADA rollouts stall on integration. Dicot ships a working platform, a dealer network that knows the plant, and support that answers the same day.

-   **Same-day expert support** for production issues, not a ticket queue.
-   **Free software updates** across the supported licence term.
-   **Deploy on-prem or in our cloud**, and change your mind later.
-   **Made in India** under Startup India, i-Hub, Wadhwani Foundation and Make in India.

FAQ

## Questions buyers ask before a demo

Short answers to the things plant teams ask us first. If yours is not here, ask us directly.

What does Dicot Innovations do?

Dicot builds SCADA, IIoT and data-acquisition software for manufacturers. Its products are Vision C (mini-SCADA and data logger), Vision S (enterprise SCADA), Vision Web (hosted cloud SCADA) and VGraphic (cloud report generator). Vision S Lite, a lighter Vision S for cost-sensitive applications, is in development. The company was founded in Ahmedabad in 2022 and its software is deployed in more than 1,000 plants.

Is Dicot's SCADA software made in India?

Yes. Dicot designs and develops its software in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. It is recognised under Startup India, incubated at i-Hub (a Gujarat Government enterprise), supported by the Wadhwani Foundation and part of the Make in India initiative.

What is the difference between Vision C, Vision S and Vision Web?

Vision C is a lightweight on-premises mini-SCADA for up to 100 tags. Vision S is an enterprise SCADA for up to 60,000 tags, with 4,000+ protocols and 21 CFR-ready audit trails. Vision Web is a cloud SCADA platform hosted by Dicot, with up to 20,000 tags per project and mobile alarms. Vision S Lite, in development, is a lighter Vision S with fewer protocols and a smaller design library for cost-sensitive applications.

Can Dicot software connect to existing PLCs and machines?

Yes. Vision C supports Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD and AIBUS. Vision S supports more than 4,000 device protocols including OPC UA and OPC DA. Vision Web receives data over MQTT and HTTP, including from Vision C.

How do I get pricing?

Dicot sells through an authorised dealer network, so prices are shared by your nearest dealer rather than published online. Send an enquiry with your tag count and deployment type and the team will route it to the right partner.

Which industries use Dicot software?

Pharmaceuticals, textiles, food and beverage, machine tools, water treatment, foundry, ceramics, railway, HVAC, chemicals, oil and gas and packaging. Deployments range from a single machine to multi-line plants.

Product suite

# SCADA software for every size of plant.

Start with a single machine and a mini-SCADA, grow into a multi-line plant, or put remote sites on a phone. Every product shares the same tag model and reporting logic, so your team learns one system.

| Product | Best for | Tags | Deployment | Licence |

| **[Vision C](/products/vision-c/)**

| **[Vision Web](/products/vision-web/)**  
Cloud SCADA & IIoT platform | Teams that need remote monitoring, multi-site visibility and mobile alarms without running servers or a VPN. | 20,000 per project | Hosted by Dicot | Yearly subscription |
| **[Vision S](/products/vision-s/)**

01 · Mini-SCADA & data logger

## Vision C

Vision C is a Windows mini-SCADA and data logger for compact machines and single lines. It handles up to 100 tags, connects over Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD and AIBUS, and pushes data to Vision Web in one click. Licences run from two years to perpetual.

Up to 100Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD, AIBUSOn-premises, WindowsUnlimited

02 · Cloud SCADA & IIoT platform

## Vision Web

Vision Web is Dicot's hosted cloud SCADA platform. It brings up to 20,000 tags per project into a browser, updates at 50–100 ms, keeps two years of history and sends alarms by SMS, email, WhatsApp and Telegram. Dicot hosts and maintains the platform; you log in and run the plant.

Up to 20,000 per projectHTTP, MQTT50–100 msManaged by Dicot

03 · Enterprise SCADA

## Vision S

Vision S is Dicot's enterprise SCADA for large and regulated plants. It scales to 60,000 tags, speaks 4,000+ protocols including OPC UA and DA, keeps 21 CFR-ready audit trails and stores history in PostgreSQL. Runtime, development, client-server and web-client licences can be mixed to fit the architecture.

Up to 60,0004,000+, OPC UA and DA21 CFR-readyPostgreSQL

Mini-SCADA & data logger

# Vision C

Shop-floor SCADA that installs in minutes, not months.

Vision C is a Windows mini-SCADA and data logger for compact machines and single lines. It handles up to 100 tags, connects over Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD and AIBUS, and pushes data to Vision Web in one click. Licences run from two years to perpetual.

### Best for

Machine builders, panel integrators and plant teams that need reliable logging and remote monitoring without a development project.

## What you get on day one.

No add-on modules to buy before the product is useful. These are part of the platform.

01

### Zero development time

Install, map your tags and start logging the same day. No screens to code, no integration project.

02

### One-click Vision Web link

Send live and historical data to the cloud without a gateway script or a second configuration.

03

### Batch recording

Record multiple batches at the same time with batch-wise reports for traceability.

04

### PID recipes

Store and recall up to 100-step recipes for repeatable process changes.

05

### Reports your team can read

Print or export PDF reports with your logo, watermark and header.

06

### Runs on modest hardware

About 10 MB installed, Windows 8 or later and 4 GB of RAM is enough.

FAQ

## Vision C: questions buyers ask

What is Vision C?

Vision C is a mini-SCADA and data-logging application for Windows. It reads tags from PLCs and devices, shows live values and trends, stores history, records batches and generates reports. It supports up to 100 tags.

Which protocols does Vision C support?

Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, BCD and AIBUS, across multiple ports.

Can Vision C send data to the cloud?

Yes. A one-click connection forwards data to Vision Web, Dicot's hosted SCADA platform, for remote monitoring and alerts.

How is Vision C licensed?

As a time-based licence of 2, 5, 10 or 20 years, or perpetual without future updates. Pricing is provided by authorised dealers.

Do I need a developer to set it up?

No. Configuration is done through the application. Most customers are logging data on the first day.

Enterprise SCADA

# Vision S

Full SCADA for regulated, high-tag-count plants.

Vision S is Dicot's enterprise SCADA for large and regulated plants. It scales to 60,000 tags, speaks 4,000+ protocols including OPC UA and DA, keeps 21 CFR-ready audit trails and stores history in PostgreSQL. Runtime, development, client-server and web-client licences can be mixed to fit the architecture.

[Book a demo](/contact/) [See plans](/pricing/)

Last updated November 2026

Vision S — product interface

Key facts

## What Vision S does.

### Best for

Pharma, process and large manufacturing sites that need audit trails, high tag counts and a configurable SCADA architecture.

<table class="spec-table"><tbody><tr><th>Tags</th><td>Up to 60,000</td></tr><tr><th>Protocols</th><td>4,000+, OPC UA and DA</td></tr><tr><th>Audit trails</th><td>21 CFR-ready</td></tr><tr><th>Historical database</th><td>PostgreSQL</td></tr><tr><th>Scripting</th><td>C</td></tr><tr><th>User levels</th><td>Unlimited</td></tr><tr><th>Recipes</th><td>Unlimited</td></tr><tr><th>Batches</th><td>Multiple simultaneous</td></tr><tr><th>Reports</th><td>Print and PDF, fully customisable</td></tr><tr><th>Extras</th><td>E-signature, OPC UA server, multi-monitor</td></tr><tr><th>Licence</th><td>Tag-based, runtime and development</td></tr></tbody></table>

Capabilities

## What you get on day one.

No add-on modules to buy before the product is useful. These are part of the platform.

01

### Audit trails that stand up

21 CFR-ready trails, electronic signatures and user-level control for regulated manufacturing.

02

### 4,000+ device protocols

Connect mixed PLCs, drives and legacy equipment through OPC UA, OPC DA and native drivers.

03

### PostgreSQL history

Plant data lands in a standard database, so your BI and reporting tools can query it directly.

04

### C scripting

Write custom logic where configuration stops being enough, without leaving the platform.

05

### Architecture that fits

Mix development, runtime, client-server and web-client licences as the plant grows.

06

### Built for the control room

Multi-monitor layouts, alarms and batch views for operators who live in the system all shift.

Plans & licensing

## Licence it the way your plant buys.

Tag-based licensing with separate development and runtime editions. Prices are shared through authorised dealers.

[Request a quote](/contact/) [Find a dealer](/contact/#channel-partners)

| Edition | What it includes |
| --- | --- |
| **Development licence** | For building and testing projects. Not for production deployment. |
| **Runtime licence** | For live deployment on the plant floor, sized by tags. |
| **Client/Server licence** | For distributed architectures without an I/O licence included. |
| **Web Client licence** | Browser-based remote operation, sized by concurrent users. |
| **Accessories** | Electronic signature and OPC UA server add-ons. |
| **Enterprise scope** | Multi-site and 60,000-tag deployments scoped with our team. |

Requirements

## What it runs on.

Modest hardware by industrial software standards. Check these before a pilot.

-   Windows 7 or Windows 10
-   Pentium 4, 1 GHz or higher
-   4 GB RAM recommended (1 GB minimum)
-   PostgreSQL for historical logging

FAQ

## Vision S: questions buyers ask

What is Vision S?

Vision S is an enterprise SCADA platform for Windows. It collects data from PLCs and devices, provides operator screens, alarms, trends, reports, recipes and batch recording, and scales to 60,000 tags.

Does Vision S support 21 CFR Part 11 requirements?

Vision S provides 21 CFR-ready audit trails, electronic signatures and user-level access control. Validation and compliance remain the responsibility of the regulated site.

Which protocols are supported?

More than 4,000 drivers, including OPC UA and OPC DA, with multi-port connectivity.

Can I develop and deploy with different licences?

Yes. Development, runtime, client-server and web-client licences are separate, and can be combined.

Where is historical data stored?

In PostgreSQL, with options for third-party integration.

Cloud SCADA & IIoT platform

# Vision Web

Your plant on any screen, with alarms where your team already is.

Vision Web is Dicot's hosted cloud SCADA platform. It brings up to 20,000 tags per project into a browser, updates at 50–100 ms, keeps two years of history and sends alarms by SMS, email, WhatsApp and Telegram. Dicot hosts and maintains the platform; you log in and run the plant.

[Book a demo](/contact/) [See plans](/pricing/)

Last updated November 2026

![Vision Web cloud SCADA dashboard showing connected projects](/images/vision-web.png)

Vision Web — product interface

Key facts

## What Vision Web does.

### Best for

Teams that need remote monitoring, multi-site visibility and mobile alarms without running servers or a VPN.

FAQ

## Vision Web: questions buyers ask

Is Vision Web hosted by Dicot?

Yes. Dicot hosts, maintains and backs up Vision Web. Customers do not need to provision cloud infrastructure or manage servers.

How fast does Vision Web update?

Typical latency is 50–100 ms on a stable connection.

How long is data retained?

Two years of historical data is retained in the platform's NoSQL store.

Which alarm channels are supported?

SMS, email, WhatsApp and Telegram, with different triggers and recipients per alarm.

Can I connect an existing PLC or Vision C installation?

Yes. Vision Web receives data over MQTT or HTTP, and Vision C can forward data with a one-click connection.

How is Vision Web priced?

As a yearly subscription by tag count, with add-ons for extra users, SMS and WhatsApp. Prices are shared through authorised dealers.

# Vision S Lite

The Vision S platform, sized for cost-sensitive plants.

Vision S Lite is a lighter edition of Vision S, in development at Dicot. It keeps the Vision S software approach but uses a reduced protocol set and a smaller design library, for applications that need Vision S-style SCADA without the full footprint.

FAQ

## Vision S Lite: questions buyers ask

What is Vision S Lite?

Vision S Lite is a lighter edition of Vision S, in development at Dicot. It keeps the Vision S software approach but uses a reduced protocol set and a smaller design library for cost-sensitive applications.

How is Vision S Lite different from Vision S?

Vision S Lite is scoped below Vision S: fewer protocols and a smaller design library. Vision S remains the choice for 60,000-tag, multi-line plants that need the full 4,000+ protocol library, OPC UA/DA and 21 CFR-ready audit trails.

Is Vision S Lite available now?

Not yet. It is in development. Register your interest and the team will share availability, editions and pricing when they are confirmed.

Who is Vision S Lite for?

Machine builders and plant teams with cost-sensitive applications that need Vision S-style SCADA, but do not need the full protocol library or design environment.

How will Vision S Lite be licensed?

Editions and pricing will be announced at launch. As with the rest of the Dicot range, quotes will be handled through authorised dealers.

Sizing

## What is a tag, really?

One tag is one value: a temperature, a pressure, a motor run status, a calculated total. If a screen shows the same value twice, that is still one tag. If you calculate efficiency from four readings, the calculated value is a fifth tag.

<table class="spec-table"><tbody><tr><th>One compact machine</th><td>20–100 tags</td></tr><tr><th>One production line</th><td>100–1,000 tags</td></tr><tr><th>Small plant</th><td>1,000–5,000 tags</td></tr><tr><th>Large or regulated plant</th><td>5,000–60,000 tags</td></tr></tbody></table>

FAQ

## Licensing questions, answered

The commercial questions we get before a quote. Ask your dealer for the numbers.

Why are prices not listed on the website?

Dicot sells through an authorised dealer network. Dealers quote in their local context, bundle installation and support, and handle taxes and purchase formalities. Send an enquiry with your tag count and the nearest dealer will respond.

What counts as a tag?

A tag is one data point the software reads, writes or calculates, such as a temperature, a motor status or a totaliser. Licences are sized by the number of tags you need in a project.

Are software updates included?

Vision C, Vision S and Vision Web include free software updates during the supported licence term. A perpetual Vision C licence does not include future updates.

Can I start small and upgrade?

Yes. Vision C can forward data to Vision Web, and Vision S licences can be extended by tags or editions. Upgrades are handled through the dealer who sold the original licence.

Do you offer development or evaluation licences?

Vision S has separate development, runtime, client-server and web-client editions so you can build before you deploy. Ask your dealer about evaluation options for your scope.

Is there a subscription for on-premise software?

Vision C is licensed for a fixed term or perpetual. Vision S is licensed by tags with separate development and runtime editions. Vision Web and VGraphic cloud are yearly subscriptions.

## Get a number for your scope.

Send tag count, protocols and whether you need on-premise or cloud. We will route it to the nearest authorised dealer.

### Before you download

**What we collect:** your name, company, work email and, if you add it, your phone number; the build you chose, the time of the request, and a Cloudflare Turnstile security token. Your IP address is used only to stop repeated automated requests.

**Why:** to send the download link or start the download, to help you if the install needs it, and to keep this form from being abused. We do not sell your data and we do not use it for unrelated advertising.

**How long:** 24 months from our last contact. Security logs are kept for up to 90 days.

**Your rights:** you can ask for access, correction or erasure, and you can withdraw consent at any time. Withdrawing is as easy as giving it: use the link in your confirmation email or write to [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech). Grievance Officer: [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech). Full detail in the [privacy policy](/legal/privacy/) (version 2.2).

This form is for business users aged 18 or over. Please do not send personal or sensitive data about anyone else.

 I agree that Dicot Innovations may use these details to send my Vision S download link and to contact me about this download. I have read the [privacy policy](/legal/privacy/). \* Send me occasional product updates. Optional, and I can unsubscribe at any time.

 [Back to all downloads](/downloads/)

This form records the request and the consent you give. We keep that record for 24 months from our last contact, then delete it.

1.  Windows 7 or Windows 10, 4 GB RAM recommended (1 GB minimum).

3.  Mount the ISO, or write it to a DVD, then run the setup inside.

## Tell us what the software is doing.

Dicot helpdesk · new ticket [Open in a new tab](https://helpdesk.dicot.tech/portal/dicot)

Tickets are handled in the support portal, a separate service with its own [privacy notice](https://helpdesk.dicot.tech/privacy). Please do not send plant passwords or other people's personal data in a ticket.

## What to include

-   The product and version — for example Vision S Version 2026, or your Vision C build.
-   Your licence ID, or the key label colour for Vision S.
-   The Windows version on the machine that is failing.
-   What you expected, what happened, and any error text.
-   A screenshot of the screen or alarm, if you can take one.
-   Whether production has stopped, slowed, or is still running.

Vision C collects from PLCs, meters and legacy devices over Modbus and serial, then forwards clean data to Vision Web or your own systems.

-   Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD and AIBUS
-   Local history that survives network outages
-   One-click cloud forwarding

Industries

# Twelve industries. One data layer.

The equipment changes; the problem does not. Collect reliable data, keep it safe, show it to the right person and raise an alarm when it drifts. Here is how that looks in each industry we serve.

[Pharmaceuticals](#pharma)[Textiles](#textiles)[Food & beverage](#food-beverage)[Machine tools](#machine-tools)[Water treatment](#water-treatment)[Foundry](#foundry)[Ceramics](#ceramics)[Railway](#railway)[HVAC](#hvac)[Chemicals](#chemical)[Oil and Gas](#oil-gas)[Packaging](#packaging)

Industry / 01

## Pharmaceuticals

Regulated production needs more than a dashboard. Vision S records who changed what, when, and why, with audit trails and electronic signatures that hold up to an audit. Batch data is stored in PostgreSQL so quality teams can query it directly.

[Built on Vision S](/products/vision-s/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   21 CFR-ready audit trails and e-signatures
-   Batch recording with multiple simultaneous batches
-   Reports with your formats and approval headers

Industry / 02

## Textiles

Dyeing, spinning and processing lines fail quietly: a temperature drifts, a batch runs long, a shift loses the register. Vision C logs the process locally and Vision Web puts the line on a supervisor's phone.

[Built on Vision C](/products/vision-c/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Multi-port Modbus data collection
-   Shift and batch reports
-   Alarms by WhatsApp or SMS when a line drifts

Industry / 03

## Food & beverage

Temperature, pressure and time decide whether a batch is safe. Dicot software records the evidence continuously and turns it into a report that quality and customers can sign off.

[Built on Vision C](/products/vision-c/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Batch-wise logging and traceability
-   Temperature and pressure alarms
-   PDF reports with logo and batch header

Industry / 04

## Machine tools

Machine builders should not become software companies. Vision C gives your machine a SCADA and data logger, and Vision Web gives your customer remote visibility — under your brand.

[Built on Vision C](/products/vision-c/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   White-label OEM editions
-   Licensing tied to machine warranty
-   One-click cloud connection for your customer

Industry / 05

## Water treatment

Water sites are remote, unmanned or both. Vision Web watches tank levels, flow, pH and conductivity, and escalates alarms to the people who can act.

[Built on Vision Web](/products/vision-web/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Level, flow and quality trending
-   SMS, WhatsApp and Telegram alarms
-   Multi-site visibility from one login

Industry / 06

## Foundry

Furnaces, moulding lines and cooling conveyors generate data in harsh conditions. Vision C runs on modest industrial PCs and keeps logging when the network does not.

[Built on Vision C](/products/vision-c/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Local history on the plant floor
-   Furnace and cooling trend logs
-   Shift comparison reports

Industry / 07

## Ceramics

Kiln cycles are long and expensive to repeat. Dicot software records the full curve, compares batches and exports the evidence for customers and process teams.

[Built on Vision S](/products/vision-s/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Long-cycle trending and history
-   Batch comparison
-   Energy and temperature reporting

Industry / 08

## Railway

Wayside and depot equipment is distributed across sites and often on poor networks. Vision C logs locally; Vision Web aggregates what matters centrally.

[Built on Vision Web](/products/vision-web/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Distributed data collection
-   Store-and-forward architecture
-   Central alarms and reports

Industry / 09

## HVAC

Comfort complaints and energy bills rarely arrive with the same owner. Vision Web tracks AHU temperatures, humidity and fan status, and alerts facilities before a space drifts.

[Built on Vision Web](/products/vision-web/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   AHU and room condition monitoring
-   Humidity and temperature alarms
-   Trends for energy reviews

Industry / 10

## Chemicals

Reactors, distillation columns and batch processes punish a missed setpoint. Dicot software logs temperature, pressure and pH continuously, alarms on deviation and keeps the batch record for audits and customers.

[Built on Vision S](/products/vision-s/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Reactor and batch trend logging
-   Temperature, pressure and pH alarms
-   Batch records with audit trail

Industry / 11

## Oil and Gas

Wells, pipelines and compressor stations sit far from the control room. Vision C logs locally at the site and Vision Web brings flow, pressure and status back to one screen, with alarms when a line drifts.

[Built on Vision Web](/products/vision-web/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Remote well and pipeline monitoring
-   Store-and-forward on poor networks
-   SMS and WhatsApp alarms

Industry / 12

## Packaging

Every stop on a packing line costs output. Dicot software counts production, tracks speed and rejects, and shows where a shift lost time — without adding another historian.

[Built on Vision C](/products/vision-c/) [Discuss your plant](/contact/)

-   Line speed and output counts
-   Downtime and reject tracking
-   Shift and production reports

Buyer's guide · updated November 2026

# SCADA alternatives in India: how to choose.

A SCADA alternative is software that delivers the core SCADA job — collect data, show it, alarm on it, store it and report on it — without the cost and deployment model of a traditional enterprise system. The three common shapes are enterprise SCADA, mini-SCADA and cloud SCADA.

## The three shapes, compared

|   | Traditional enterprise SCADA | Mini-SCADA | Cloud SCADA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Typical scope** | Whole plant, many lines | One machine or line | Remote and multi-site monitoring |
| **Tag ceiling** | 10,000–100,000+ | Up to 100 | 10–20,000 per project |
| **Deployment** | On-premise servers | One Windows PC | Vendor-hosted |
| **Time to first data** | Weeks to months | Hours to days | Hours |
| **Works offline** | Yes | Yes | Partial — local buffering needed |
| **Remote access** | VPN or web client | Via cloud forwarding | Native, browser and mobile |
| **Audit trails** | Usually | Basic | Varies |
| **Licensing** | Tag + client + module | Term or perpetual | Yearly subscription |
| **IT burden** | High | Low | Low |

Ranges are typical of the category, not a specific competitor. Confirm limits with any vendor before you buy.

Five questions

## Ask these before you sign.

The answers decide more than the feature list.

1.  **How many tags will you actually need in three years?** Buy for the plant you will have, not the pilot.
2.  **What happens when the internet drops?** Control must keep running locally; only the remote view should depend on the cloud.
3.  **Who owns the historical data?** Ask for export in a standard format, not a proprietary dump.
4.  **Which protocols are supported natively?** Every unsupported driver becomes a custom integration line item.
5.  **What does year three cost?** Renewals, client licences, support and update policy matter more than the first invoice.

Where Dicot fits

## One portfolio, four answers.

We make every shape, so the honest answer can be "the smaller one".

Mini-SCADA

### Vision C

One compact machine or line, up to 100 tags, on-premise, Modbus and serial. Term or perpetual licence.

[Vision C →](/products/vision-c/)

Cloud SCADA

### Vision Web

Remote monitoring, up to 20,000 tags per project, mobile alarms, hosted by Dicot. Yearly subscription.

[Vision Web →](/products/vision-web/)

Enterprise SCADA

### Vision S

Up to 60,000 tags, 4,000+ protocols, 21 CFR-ready audit trails, PostgreSQL history. Runtime and development editions.

[Vision S →](/products/vision-s/)

Lighter enterprise SCADA

### Vision S Lite In development

A lighter Vision S with fewer protocols and a smaller design library, for cost-sensitive applications.

[Vision S Lite →](/products/vision-s-lite/)

Honest limits

## When Dicot is not the right choice.

A good evaluation includes the cases where you should walk away.

-   Safety-instrumented systems and SIL-rated control. Use a certified safety system, not SCADA software.
-   Hard real-time control loops below 50 ms on non-Windows controllers.
-   Full MES, ERP, warehouse or maintenance management. We integrate; we do not replace them.
-   Plants above 60,000 tags in a single on-premise project — talk to us about a multi-server architecture first.
-   Sites that cannot use Windows for on-premise deployments and cannot use a hosted cloud.

FAQ

## SCADA alternative questions

What is a SCADA alternative?

A SCADA alternative is software that provides the core SCADA functions — data collection, operator screens, alarms, trends, history and reports — without the cost and deployment model of a traditional enterprise SCADA. Common alternatives are mini-SCADA for single machines and cloud SCADA for remote monitoring.

Is a mini-SCADA enough for a full plant?

Often, no. A mini-SCADA such as Vision C is designed for up to 100 tags, typically one machine or a compact line. A plant with multiple lines, recipes, audit trails and long history needs an enterprise platform such as Vision S or a cloud platform such as Vision Web.

Can cloud SCADA replace on-premise SCADA?

For monitoring and alarming, usually yes. For high-speed control, safety functions or sites with unreliable connectivity, keep control on-premise and send data to the cloud. Most plants end up with a hybrid architecture.

How do I compare SCADA licensing models?

Compare the total cost over the plant's life, not the sticker price. Check tag limits, runtime versus development editions, client licences, update policy and what happens when you need 20% more tags. Ask for the renewal cost in writing.

Does Dicot replace a full MES or ERP?

No. Dicot provides the SCADA, IIoT and reporting layer between machines and business systems. It can forward data to MES, ERP or BI tools, but it is not an MES or ERP.

Which Dicot product is the right alternative?

For a compact machine or line up to 100 tags, Vision C. For cost-sensitive scopes that need Vision S-style software, Vision S Lite is in development. For a large or regulated plant up to 60,000 tags with audit trails, Vision S. For remote monitoring with mobile alarms, Vision Web. For shift reports, VGraphic.

## Compare on your own tag list.

Send the tag count, protocols and site constraints. We will tell you which shape fits, including when it is not ours.

title: "Cloud SCADA vs On-Premise SCADA | Dicot"
description: "Cloud SCADA or on-premise? Compare latency, offline operation, cost, security, remote access and scale — and see when a hybrid architecture is the right answer."
url: "https://dicot.tech/compare/cloud-vs-on-premise-scada/"
markdown_url: "https://dicot.tech/compare/cloud-vs-on-premise-scada/index.md"
updated: "2026-11-23"
---

<!-- Markdown mirror of https://dicot.tech/compare/cloud-vs-on-premise-scada/. The HTML page remains the source of truth. -->
Comparison · updated November 2026

# Cloud SCADA vs on-premise SCADA.

Cloud SCADA runs on a vendor-hosted platform and is reached through a browser or mobile app. On-premise SCADA runs on servers inside the plant. The right choice is usually both: control stays local, monitoring goes to the cloud.

| Factor | Cloud SCADA | On-premise SCADA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Update latency** | 50–100 ms typical, dependent on link | Milliseconds, local network |
| **Offline operation** | Needs local buffering for gaps | Full operation without internet |
| **Remote access** | Native, any browser or phone | VPN, remote desktop or web client |
| **Upfront cost** | Low — subscription | Higher — server, licences, setup |
| **Long-term cost** | Recurring subscription | Support and renewals, no hosting |
| **IT workload** | Vendor handles patching and uptime | Your team handles servers and backups |
| **Data location** | Vendor infrastructure | Inside the plant |
| **Scale** | Add tags and sites without hardware | Add servers and licences |
| **Best fit** | Remote sites, multi-site, small teams | Regulated, high-speed or air-gapped plants |

The usual answer

## Hybrid, with control at the edge.

The plant keeps a local logger that runs the line and stores history. The cloud receives a copy for remote monitoring, alarms and management reporting. If the network drops, production does not.

<table class="spec-table"><tbody><tr><th>Edge</th><td>Vision C — local logging, alarms and forwarding</td></tr><tr><th>Cloud</th><td>Vision Web — browser, mobile, WhatsApp/Telegram alarms</td></tr><tr><th>Enterprise</th><td>Vision S — 60,000 tags, audit trails, PostgreSQL</td></tr><tr><th>Reports</th><td>VGraphic — branded PDF output from plant files</td></tr></tbody></table>

### Choose cloud when…

-   Your sites are remote or unmanned.
-   Operators and managers need phone access.
-   You do not want to run servers or a VPN.
-   You need to add sites without buying hardware.
-   Alarms must reach people on WhatsApp, SMS or Telegram.

### Choose on-premise when…

-   The process cannot stop when the internet does.
-   Audit trails and data residency must stay in the plant.
-   Scan rates are high and latency matters.
-   The site is air-gapped by policy.
-   You already run industrial servers and OT security.

FAQ

## Deployment questions

Is cloud SCADA secure enough for a factory?

Security depends on the design, not the location. A hosted platform needs encryption in transit and at rest, strong authentication, role-based access and a clear data-ownership agreement. An on-premise system needs patching, network segmentation and backups. Both can be secure or badly run; ask for specifics.

What happens to data when the internet goes down?

In a hybrid setup, the local logger keeps collecting and buffering. When the link returns, it forwards the backlog. Control continues locally; only the remote view is interrupted.

Is cloud SCADA cheaper?

It moves cost from capital to operating expense and removes server maintenance, but a long subscription can cost more than a perpetual licence over ten years. Compare total cost over the plant's life, including IT staff time.

Can I move from on-premise to cloud later?

Usually yes, if the on-premise product can forward data to the cloud. Vision C forwards to Vision Web with a one-click connection, so a plant can start local and add cloud visibility without replacing its logger.

Which does Dicot recommend?

Keep control on-premise and put monitoring in the cloud unless you have a specific reason to do otherwise. That is why Vision C forwards to Vision Web, and why Vision S can expose data through APIs and web clients.

## Design the architecture with us.

Tell us the sites, the tags and what happens when the link drops. We will draw the simplest architecture that survives it.

About Dicot

# Industrial software from Ahmedabad, for the world.

Dicot Innovations builds SCADA, IIoT and data-acquisition software for manufacturers. We started in 2022 with a simple observation: the plants that need data most are often the ones least able to afford a six-month integration project.

**800+**customers

**1,000+**deployments

**4,000+**device protocols

**50–100 ms**cloud update latency

Our story

## Built by people who commission plants.

Dicot was founded in Ahmedabad in 2022 by a small team with background in industrial automation. The first product, Vision C, was a reaction to what we saw on shop floors: capable machines, no usable history, and reports assembled by hand at the end of every shift.

Today the suite covers a mini-SCADA, an enterprise SCADA and a hosted cloud platform, used by more than 800 customers across 1,000+ deployments. The core team is six people, backed by directors and mentors from the automation industry.

We are recognised under Startup India, incubated at i-Hub (a Gujarat Government enterprise), supported by the Wadhwani Foundation and part of the Make in India initiative.

### What we optimise for

-   **Time to first data.** A product should be useful before the project plan is approved.
-   **Support that answers.** Production does not wait for a ticket queue.
-   **Software a plant can afford.** Pricing that matches the size of the problem.

## A product you can support, not a project you have to code.

title: "Dicot MCP API | Read-only SCADA data for AI agents"
description: "JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint serving published Dicot product facts, download options and contact details. No auth, read-only, no personal data, 60 requests per minute per IP."
url: "https://dicot.tech/mcp/"

updated: "2026-11-23"

<!-- Markdown mirror of https://dicot.tech/mcp/. The HTML page remains the source of truth. -->
Machine access

# The Dicot MCP API.

A read-only JSON-RPC endpoint that serves published facts about Dicot SCADA, IIoT and data-acquisition software: products, download options and contact details. Built for AI agents and integrations.

### Endpoint

https://dicot.tech/mcp.php

JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST. GET is rejected with 405.

### Protocol

MCP Streamable HTTP. Protocol versions: 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26.

### Access

No authentication. Every tool carries a read-only annotation. No personal data is accepted or stored.

### Rate limit

60 requests per minute per IP address. A 429 response carries Retry-After: 60.

Reference

## Methods and tools.

Prices never appear in any response: Dicot sells through authorised dealers and does not publish prices.

### JSON-RPC methods

| Method | Purpose | Params |
| --- | --- | --- |
| initialize | Handshake. Returns the negotiated protocol version, capabilities and server instructions. | protocolVersion (optional) |
| ping | Liveness check. Returns an empty result. | none |
| tools/list | Lists the four read-only tools with their input schemas. | none |
| tools/call | Runs one tool and returns text and structured content. | name, arguments |
| server/discover | Server information, capabilities and protocol versions in one call. | none |
| notifications/initialized · notifications/cancelled | Accepted and acknowledged with HTTP 202 and no body. | none |

### Tools

-   **search\_dicot\_products** — Search Dicot SCADA, IIoT and reporting software by product name, protocol, industry or use case. Returns matching products with a summary and canonical URL. Input: query (string, required) — a product name or keyword, for example “OPC UA”, “pharma” or “cloud”..
-   **get\_dicot\_product** — Return the published specification, editions, requirements and FAQs for one Dicot product. Prices are never returned. Input: product (string, required) — vision-c, vision-s, vision-web, vision-s-lite or vgraphic..
-   **get\_dicot\_download\_options** — List public installers and manuals, and explain that the two Vision S builds need a request form with name, company and work email. Input: none.
-   **get\_dicot\_contact** — Return the Dicot office address, sales and privacy email addresses, phone numbers and the authorised channel partners. Input: none.

### Example requests

```
curl -X POST https://dicot.tech/mcp.php \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
```

```
curl -X POST https://dicot.tech/mcp.php \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_dicot_product","arguments":{"product":"vision-s"}}}'
```

Responses are JSON-RPC 2.0: a result object with content and structuredContent, or an error object with a code and message.

### Machine-readable discovery

-   API catalog (RFC 9727): [/.well-known/api-catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog)
-   OpenAPI 3.1 description of this endpoint: [/.well-known/mcp/openapi.json](/.well-known/mcp/openapi.json)
-   MCP Server Card (SEP-2127): [/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json](/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
-   Health and status document: [/.well-known/health.json](/.well-known/health.json)
-   Agent guidance in plain text: [/llms.txt](/llms.txt) and [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt)
-   AI catalog: [/.well-known/ai-catalog.json](/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)

robots.txt declares Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no: pages may be indexed and quoted in answers, not used for model training. Every page also has a Markdown mirror at the same URL plus index.md, served when a request sends Accept: text/markdown.

## Talking to a person.

For quotes, demos or integration questions, use the [contact form](/contact/) or write to sales@dicot.tech. Vision S installers are requested at the [downloads page](/downloads/vision-s/), not through the API.

Legal · updated 20 November 2026

# Privacy Policy

This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how long we keep it and how you can exercise your rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025.

**Effective date:** 20 November 2026 · **Version:** 2.2

## 1\. Who we are

Dicot Innovations Private Limited (“Dicot”, “we”, “us”) is the Data Fiduciary for the personal data described in this policy. We are registered in India with our office at A-805, Siddhi Vinayak Towers, Off S. G. Road, B/H DCP Office, Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380051, India.

-   Privacy and data requests: [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech)
-   Grievance Officer: [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech)
-   General contact: [sales@dicot.tech](mailto:sales@dicot.tech) · +91 90166 83114

## 2\. Scope

This policy covers personal data processed through **dicot.tech** and **dicot.in**, including our contact form, partner application link, careers applications, downloads, blog, support portal and analytics. Our customer platform at vision-web.tech may have a separate notice; where it does, that notice applies to that service.

This policy does not cover personal data in customer plant data that we process as a processor under a customer contract.

## 3\. Personal data we collect

| Category | What we collect | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enquiries | Name, company, work email, phone, product interest, message | To answer your enquiry, arrange a demo and route it to a dealer |
| Partner applications | Name, company, email, phone, territory and business details | To assess and manage a dealer, integrator or OEM partnership |
| Careers | Name, email, phone, CV and the role you apply for | To assess your application and contact you about it |
| Support and licences | Name, company, contact details, product and licence identifiers | To provide support, renewals and warranty service |
| Analytics (with consent) | Pages viewed, approximate location derived from IP, device and browser, referrer, interaction events | To understand which content helps buyers and improve the site |
| Support chat (with consent) | Name and message you type in the Tawk.to chat, chat identifiers and the pages viewed during the chat | To answer your question and keep the conversation in context |
| Contact form anti-spam check | IP address and CAPTCHA verification token | Cloudflare Turnstile uses these to verify contact-form submissions and reduce spam |
| Vision S download requests | Name, company, work email, optional phone, the build selected, the consent text and its timestamp, IP address and CAPTCHA token | To send the download link or start the download, help with installation, and prevent automated abuse |
| Support tickets | Name, email, subject, description, department, attachments you add, ticket number, replies and status history | To record, answer and track your support request |
| Security logs | IP address, user agent, request time and status | To keep the site available and investigate abuse |

We do not intentionally collect sensitive personal data such as health, biometric, caste, religious or political information through this website. Please do not send it through the contact form or a support ticket.

**Vision S downloads.** The installers are large files, so before sending a temporary link or starting a download we ask for your name, company and work email, and optionally a phone number. We record the build you chose, the time of the request and the consent you give, and we use your IP address only to stop automated abuse. We use this data to deliver the file, help with installation and keep the form from being misused. It is not used for unrelated advertising, and the marketing opt-in on that form is optional and separate.

**Support tickets.** The ticket form on our support page runs in our own helpdesk at helpdesk.dicot.tech. When you open a ticket we collect your name, email address, the subject and description you write, the department you choose and any attachments you add, and we keep the replies and status changes on that ticket. We use it to answer you, to keep the history of the issue for your site, and to see whether the same fault is recurring. That portal is a separate service and shows its own privacy notice.

## 4\. How we use personal data

-   Respond to enquiries, demos and partner applications.
-   Provide, licence, support and renew our software.
-   Send product updates where you have opted in.
-   Measure site usage where you have consented to analytics.
-   Protect the site, prevent fraud and comply with legal obligations.

We do not sell personal data, and we do not use enquiry data for unrelated advertising.

## 5\. Consent and withdrawal

Where we rely on consent, we ask for it separately and do not pre-tick the box. You can withdraw consent at any time by writing to [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech) or by changing your cookie choices through “Cookie settings” in the footer. Withdrawal does not affect processing already carried out, and we will stop using the data for that purpose. You can also ask us to delete it, subject to legal retention requirements.

**Download consent.** The Vision S download form asks for a separate consent that is never pre-ticked. Every confirmation email repeats how to withdraw it, and a request to [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech) with the subject “Withdraw download consent” is actioned without any further steps. Withdrawal does not affect the download you already received, and it is as easy to withdraw as it was to consent.

## 6\. Cookies and analytics

Essential storage keeps your consent choice and the site working. Google Analytics 4 loads only after you accept analytics, and the Tawk.to chat widget loads only after you enable support chat. Neither loads if you reject or ignore the banner. See the [cookie policy](/legal/cookies/) for the specific cookies and durations. Our support portal runs on its own domain and keeps its own session storage there; it is not readable by dicot.tech.

## 7\. Sharing and processors

We share personal data only where needed, with:

| Recipient | Purpose | Location |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hostinger | Website hosting and email | EU / India, per plan |
| Dicot support portal (self-hosted) | Support ticket intake, tracking and replies | Same hosting and email providers as this website |
| Cloudflare | DNS, CDN and security | Global |
| Google (Analytics, Forms) | Consented analytics; partner application form | Global |
| Tawk.to | Live chat, only when you enable support chat | Global |
| Authorised dealers | Responding to your enquiry or quote in your territory | India / your region |
| Professional advisers and authorities | Legal, audit or regulatory requirements | India |

Processors act on our instructions under contract. Some may process data outside India; where they do, we take steps required by the DPDP Act and Rules. The partner application opens a Google Form, so Google’s own terms and cookies apply to that form. The live-chat widget is loaded from Tawk.to only after you enable support chat, and Tawk.to's own terms apply while you use it.

## 8\. Retention

| Data | Retention |
| --- | --- |
| Enquiries and demo requests | 24 months from last contact |
| Partner applications | 24 months from last contact |
| Vision S download requests | 24 months from last contact |
| Job applications | 12 months, unless you ask us to delete earlier |
| Customer, licence and support records | For the contract term and as required by law |
| Support tickets | 24 months from the last update on the ticket |
| Analytics | Up to 14 months in Google Analytics |
| Support chat transcripts | Up to 12 months from the last message |
| Security logs | Up to 90 days |

When retention ends, we delete or anonymise the data.

## 9\. Security

We use HTTPS, access controls, least-privilege accounts, patched infrastructure, backups and vendor contracts with confidentiality obligations. No system is completely secure; if you suspect a problem, contact [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech) immediately.

## 10\. Data breaches

If a personal data breach occurs, we will contain it, assess the risk and notify the Data Protection Board of India and affected Data Principals as required by the DPDP Act and DPDP Rules, 2025. We keep an internal record of breaches and remedial actions.

## 11\. Your rights

As a Data Principal you can ask us to:

-   confirm whether we process your personal data and provide a summary;
-   correct, complete or update inaccurate data;
-   erase data that is no longer needed for its purpose;
-   nominate another person to exercise your rights in the event of death or incapacity;
-   withdraw consent; and
-   resolve a grievance.

Write to [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech) with the subject “DPDP request”. We may ask for information to verify your identity. We aim to respond within 30 days or the period prescribed under the DPDP Rules. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

## 12\. Children

Our website and products are intended for businesses and are not directed to children under 18. We do not knowingly collect children’s personal data. If you believe a child has provided data, contact us and we will delete it.

## 13\. Marketing

We send product updates only where you opt in, and every message includes an unsubscribe route. You can also ask us to stop by emailing [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech).

## 14\. Changes to this policy

We will update this page when our processing changes and revise the effective date and version. Material changes will be communicated where required.

## 15\. Contact and grievance redressal

Grievance Officer, Dicot Innovations Private Limited  
A-805, Siddhi Vinayak Towers, Off S. G. Road, B/H DCP Office, Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380051, India  
Email: [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech)  
Phone: +91 90166 83114

# Refund & Cancellation Policy

Software licences and cloud subscriptions are digital products. This page explains when an order can be cancelled or refunded.

**Effective date:** 18 November 2026 · **Version:** 2.0

## 1\. Cancellation before delivery

If you cancel an order before a licence key is generated or a cloud subscription is activated, the order amount is refunded in full. Cancel by writing to [sales@dicot.tech](mailto:sales@dicot.tech) with the order or invoice number.

## 2\. After a licence is generated

A software licence cannot be cancelled or refunded once the licence key has been issued, because the product can be used immediately. This applies to Vision C, Vision S, VGraphic and cloud activations.

## 3\. Cloud subscriptions

Cloud subscriptions are paid in advance. Cancellation stops the next renewal; the current period is not refunded. If you cancel, export your data before the period ends. We retain cloud data as described in the [privacy policy](/legal/privacy/) and your order terms.

## 4\. Physical goods

If a physical item has shipped but has not been delivered, the order can be cancelled and the amount refunded after deducting shipping and handling, once the item is returned intact. Delivered items cannot be cancelled.

## 5\. Failed or duplicate transactions

If a payment fails but money is debited, or the same order is charged twice, the affected amount is refunded. Send the transaction reference and invoice number to [sales@dicot.tech](mailto:sales@dicot.tech). Bank or card charges may not be refundable.

## 6\. Processing time

Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days on our side. Your bank or card issuer may take longer to credit the amount. We cannot guarantee a specific credit date once the refund leaves us.

## 7\. Partial cancellations

Where an order includes multiple items and only some are cancelled, the refund corresponds to the cancelled part.

## 8\. Changes

We may update this policy. The version on this page applies to orders placed after its effective date.

## 9\. Contact

Dicot Innovations Private Limited  
A-805, Siddhi Vinayak Towers, Off S. G. Road, B/H DCP Office, Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380051, India  
[sales@dicot.tech](mailto:sales@dicot.tech) · +91 90166 83114

# Cookie Policy

We keep cookies to a minimum. Essential storage runs the site; analytics and support chat load only after you accept them, and we do not run advertising cookies.

**Effective date:** 18 November 2026 · **Version:** 2.0

## What we use

| Name | Type | Purpose | Duration | Consent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dicot\_consent\_v1 | Local storage | Remembers your cookie choice so we do not ask on every page | Until you clear browser storage | Essential |
| \_\_cf\_bm | Cookie | Cloudflare bot management and security | 30 minutes | Essential |
| \_ga | Cookie | Google Analytics 4 — distinguishes browsers for aggregate usage reporting | Up to 2 years | Analytics |
| \_ga\_<container> | Cookie | Google Analytics 4 — keeps session state | Up to 2 years | Analytics |
| \_\_tawkuuid | Cookie | Tawk.to live chat — recognises a returning chat visitor | Up to 6 months | Support chat |
| TawkConnectionTime | Cookie | Tawk.to live chat — manages the chat connection | Session | Support chat |
| tawk\_uuid\_<property> | Cookie | Tawk.to live chat — keeps the chat session across pages | Up to 6 months | Support chat |

We do not currently set advertising or marketing cookies. If that changes, we will add the category here and ask for consent before setting them.

## Third-party services

The partner application link opens a Google Form. Once you visit Google, Google’s cookies and privacy terms apply. Our fonts are self-hosted, so loading a page does not contact Google Fonts. The Tawk.to live-chat widget is loaded from Tawk.to only if you enable “Support chat” in the cookie preferences; its own cookies and privacy terms apply to the chat service. The contact form loads Cloudflare Turnstile to prevent automated spam; Cloudflare processes the verification token and IP address under its [privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

## How to change your choice

Use the “Cookie settings” link in the footer to reopen the banner and change analytics, support-chat or marketing consent. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings; blocking essential storage may make the consent banner reappear on each visit.

Rejecting analytics or chat does not restrict any part of the site. The contact form and downloads work without either.

## Do Not Track and AI crawlers

We do not use a separate Do Not Track response. Automated crawlers are governed by our [robots.txt](/robots.txt); we allow standard search engines and AI assistants to read public pages.

## More information

For the wider picture of how we handle personal data, see the [privacy policy](/legal/privacy/) or write to [privacy@dicot.tech](mailto:privacy@dicot.tech).

Careers

# Build software that runs the plant floor.

Dicot is a six-person core team in Ahmedabad building SCADA and IIoT products used in more than 1,000 deployments. Small team, short decisions, real customers.

### Own a product, not a ticket

Engineers here talk to the plant, not just to a backlog. What you build is commissioned by someone you can call.

### Industrial scale, startup speed

Your work reaches hundreds of manufacturers without passing through five approval layers.

### Ahmedabad, on-site

We work from the Makarba office. Roles are listed with their location when they open.

Open roles

## Current openings.

Roles are added here as they open. If nothing fits today, send your CV anyway.

Field Application & Deployment Intern Engineering & Deployments · Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site / Field Travel) · Internship · Students / Recent Graduates Details & apply

Get hands-on industrial automation experience assisting with on-site installations, panel wiring checks, and protocol testing for Dicot Innovations' IIoT and SCADA platforms. You will shadow deployment engineers at client plants, help configure edge gateways and Vision S/Vision Web setups, and document field diagnostics.

**Salary / stipend:** 5k - 10k per month

[Apply for this role](#apply)

Field Application Engineer (Fresher) Engineering & Deployments · Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site / Field Travel) · Full-time · 0-1 years (Freshers) Details & apply

Lead on-site commissioning, hardware integration, and technical support for Dicot Innovations' Industrial IoT and SCADA systems (Vision S, Vision C, and Vision Web). You will work directly at manufacturing facilities to configure PLCs, sensors, and industrial communication protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, RS-485), troubleshoot edge deployments, and ensure seamless plant-floor operations.

**Salary / stipend:** 3LPA + Performance Incentives

[Apply for this role](#apply)

Growth Associate/BDE (Fresher) Sales & Marketing · Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) · Full-time · 0-1 years (Freshers) Details & apply

Kickstart your B2B tech career by driving market adoption for Dicot Innovations' Industrial IoT, SCADA, and automation platforms (Vision S, Vision C, and Vision Web). You will handle outbound lead generation, coordinate product demos for manufacturing clients, assist with marketing campaigns, and build relationships across industrial sectors.

**Salary / stipend:** 3.6LPA + Performance Incentives

[Apply for this role](#apply)

Business Development & Growth Intern Sales & Marketing · Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) · Internship · Students / Recent Graduates Details & apply

Gain hands-on experience in B2B industrial tech sales and marketing at Dicot Innovations. You will support market research, identify potential manufacturing leads, assist in preparing client proposals and digital outreach for Vision S and Vision Web, and shadow senior team members during client pitches.

**Salary / stipend:** 5k - 10k per month

[Apply for this role](#apply)
